title: Borrow a GPU
story: To test something on a GPU, ask Slurm for an interactive session with one GPU. Check that you can see it, then give it back.

tasks.text: Start an interactive job with 1 GPU
Leave the job so the GPU is free again

hints: `srun --gres=gpu:1 --pty bash` starts an interactive shell with one GPU.
Inside it, `nvidia-smi` shows only your GPU. `exit` ends the job.
